Added regression coverage for supported mixed-case extensions, unsupported extensions/no extension, and `None`.

Verification run:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-pydeps python3 -m pytest tests/test_templating.py -q
PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-pydeps python3 -m pytest tests -q
git diff --check
```

Results: 40 focused tests passed; 499 full-suite tests passed.
